plugins.name: web-blink
plugins.description: It takes just a blink to control the web. Web Blink learns how web services and web apps work, then hands them to you as reviewed, ready-to-run actions, so you can automate your work from Claude Code or the command line (web-blink, or just blink).

plugins.name: usb-checker
plugins.description: Run a direct, read-only USB safety and bounded malware check on a Linux host.

plugins.name: blink-debugger
plugins.description: Inspect local device observation exports and check Linux host readiness and listeners.

plugins.name: minion-control
plugins.description: Operate Minion from Claude Code: in a master session or a session with grants, see what it can reach, read other sessions, prompt other agents, and allow the Minion commands for master sessions. Ordinary sessions are told nothing.
